<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Quote request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price and delivery estimates"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryBatch" name="Delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Email complaining about webshops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteRequest" name="Query all web shops"
                      sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"
                      messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts order"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialDelivery" name="First delivery batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Reorder from cheapest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Reorder from fastest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterDelivery" name="Further delivery batches"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_StartLaterBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive availability, price and delivery estimates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Compare offers and allocate parts to the cheapest shops where needed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial parts orders"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive the first parts batch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Batches arrive in random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Build" name="Build project and manage stock">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Build" name="First parts batch received"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build project"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Build" name="Project building complete"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Start" sourceRef="Start_Build" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="End_Build"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_LaterBatches" name="Receive further delivery batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartLaterBatch" name="Further parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_AddBatchToStock" name="Add received batch to stock"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndLaterBatch" name="Batch added to stock"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_Add" sourceRef="Event_StartLaterBatch" targetRef="Task_AddBatchToStock"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_End" sourceRef="Task_AddBatchToStock" targetRef="Event_EndLaterBatch"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_BelowFive" name="Reorder when stock falls below five" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartBelowFive" name="A part's stock falls below five" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_BelowFive">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 5</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndBelowFive" name="Cheapest-shop reorder sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_Reorder" sourceRef="Event_StartBelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_End" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Event_EndBelowFive"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_BelowThree" name="Reorder when stock falls below three" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartBelowThree" name="A part's stock falls below three" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_BelowThree">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 3</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part from the fastest shop"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndBelowThree" name="Fastest-shop reorder sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_Reorder" sourceRef="Event_StartBelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_End" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Event_EndBelowThree"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_ZeroStock" name="Complain when stock reaches zero" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartZeroStock" name="A part's stock reaches zero" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_ZeroStock">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part = 0</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the webshops"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_EndZeroStock" name="Complaint email sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroStock_Email" sourceRef="Event_StartZeroStock" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroStock_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Event_EndZeroStock"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Contract" name="Contract project complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Lists" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Orders" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orders_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="SubProcess_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_ContractEnd" sourceRef="SubProcess_Build" targetRef="End_Contract"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Query to web shops"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryBatch" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Email complaining about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query all web shops"
                      sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Web shop offers"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"
                      messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts orders"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterBatch" name="Further parts batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_StartLaterBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Order part from cheapest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Order part from fastest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract project">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive availability, price and delivery time from all shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Offers_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SufficientSupply" name="Can one shop supply the required parts?"
                           default="Flow_Supply_Split">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Offers_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Supply_OneShop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Supply_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateOneShop" name="Allocate parts to the cheapest shop that can supply them">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Supply_OneShop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OneShop_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" name="Allocate parts across several shops using the cheapest parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Supply_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllocationMerge" name="Allocation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OneShop_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Lists</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Lists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Lists_Orders</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrders" name="Order parts from the selected web shops">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Lists_Orders</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Orders_FirstBatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive the first parts batch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Orders_FirstBatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FirstBatch_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndStock" name="Build project and manage stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FirstBatch_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_End</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Build" name="First parts batch received">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_StartTask</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build project">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_StartTask</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_CheckFive</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowFive" name="Has stock for a single part fallen below 5?"
                             default="Flow_NotBelowFive">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_CheckFive</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowFive_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotBelowFive</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowFive_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cheapest_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeBelowFive" name="Below-five check complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cheapest_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotBelowFive</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeFive_CheckThree</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowThree" name="Has stock for a single part fallen below 3?"
                             default="Flow_NotBelowThree">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeFive_CheckThree</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThree_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotBelowThree</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part again from the fastest shop">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThree_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fastest_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeBelowThree" name="Below-three check complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fastest_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotBelowThree</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeThree_CheckZero</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ZeroStock" name="Is stock for a single part zero?"
                             default="Flow_NotZero">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeThree_CheckZero</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotZero</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the web shops">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_Email</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeZero" name="Zero-stock check complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotZero</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Build" name="Building and stock checks complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_LaterBatches" name="Receive further parts batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_StartLaterBatch" name="Further parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LaterBatch_Add</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_AddBatchToStock" name="Add received batch to stock">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LaterBatch_Add</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LaterBatch_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LaterBatch" name="Batch added to stock">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LaterBatch_End</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_Add" sourceRef="Event_StartLaterBatch" targetRef="Task_AddBatchToStock"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_End" sourceRef="Task_AddBatchToStock" targetRef="End_LaterBatch"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_StartTask" sourceRef="Start_Build" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_CheckFive" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="Gateway_BelowFive"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_Reorder" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowFive" name="Stock is at least 5" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowFive"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowFive"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeFive_CheckThree" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeBelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_BelowThree"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_Reorder" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowThree" name="Stock is at least 3" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowThree"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBelowThree"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeThree_CheckZero" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeBelowThree" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_Email" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotZero" name="Stock is not zero" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZero"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZero"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_End" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeZero" targetRef="End_Build"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Contract" name="Contract project workflow complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Gateway_SufficientSupply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Supply_OneShop" name="One shop has sufficient parts" sourceRef="Gateway_SufficientSupply" targetRef="Task_AllocateOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">a shop can supply the required parts</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Supply_Split" name="No single shop has sufficient parts" sourceRef="Gateway_SufficientSupply" targetRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AllocateOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Lists" sourceRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Orders" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orders_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndStock" targetRef="End_Contract"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Quote request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price and delivery estimates"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryBatch" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email about webshops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteRequest" name="Query all web shops"
                      sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"
                      messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrders" name="Initial parts orders"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterBatches" name="Further parts batches"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_LaterBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" name="Order from cheapest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" name="Order from fastest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive availability, prices and delivery times"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Allocate parts to the cheapest shops, using several shops if needed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial parts orders"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected. Building starts when the first parts arrive, while other batches may still be pending.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build project"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ZeroStock" name="Is stock for a single part zero?" default="Flow_ZeroStock_No"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the webshops"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Complaint email sent"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowFive" name="Is stock for a single part below five?" default="Flow_BelowFive_No"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowThree" name="Is stock for a single part below three?" default="Flow_BelowThree_No"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part from the fastest shop"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReorderMerge" name="Continue building"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_ZeroCheck" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroStock_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroStock_EmailEnd" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroStock_No" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroStock" targetRef="Gateway_BelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive_No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_BelowThree" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_BelowThree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock for a single part < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree_No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_ReorderMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderMerge_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_LaterBatches" name="Receive further parts batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_LaterBatch" name="Further parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_AddBatchToStock" name="Add received batch to stock"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LaterBatch" name="Batch added to stock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_AddStock" sourceRef="Event_LaterBatch" targetRef="Task_AddBatchToStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddStock_EndLaterBatch" sourceRef="Task_AddBatchToStock" targetRef="End_LaterBatch"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Lists" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Orders" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orders_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Web shop query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryBatch" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteRequest" name="Query all web shops"
                      sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"
                      messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrders" name="Initial parts orders"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterBatches" name="Further parts batches"
                      sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_LaterBatch"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" name="Order from cheapest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" name="Order from fastest shop"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsEmail" name="Complaint email"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsEmail"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive availability, prices and delivery times"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Select the cheapest parts and allocate orders across shops if needed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial parts orders"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build the contract project"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Event_LaterBatch" name="Further parts batch arrives"
                        attachedToRef="Task_BuildProject" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:documentation>Further batches may arrive in random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterBatch" messageRef="Message_DeliveryBatch"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddBatchToStock" name="Add received batch to stock"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BatchAdded" name="Batch added to stock"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockThresholds" name="Check stock for a single part"
                           default="Flow_Stock_NoAction"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the part from the cheapest shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the part from the fastest shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the web shops"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" name="Join applicable stock responses"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockResponses" name="Stock responses completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Lists" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Orders" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orders_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterBatch_AddStock" sourceRef="Event_LaterBatch" targetRef="Task_AddBatchToStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddStock_EndBatch" sourceRef="Task_AddBatchToStock" targetRef="End_BatchAdded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Thresholds" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="Gateway_StockThresholds"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_BelowFive" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_BelowThree" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Join" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" targetRef="End_StockResponses"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
